symmetry_sector_count.source: Harness anchor: exact enumeration of distinct (N_I, N_II) pairs over all 2^L configurations, directly from the instruction's own definitions; cross-checked against Fig. 2a dot positions. Earlier digitized values tracked the guide line, not the data.

krylov_subspace_count.source: Harness anchor: exact connected-component count under the instruction's hop rules, by two independent methods (BFS and union-find, agreeing at every L); validated against the paper's Fig. 1b example (L=11 sector N_I=N_II=7 -> exactly 2 subspaces, sizes 103+4) and Fig. 2a dot positions. Earlier digitized values snapped to the ~1.5^L guide line (e.g. 3000 vs actual 6240 at L=20).
